title: Translating sulfur flow batteries into deployable systems
authors: Fei Ai
Jiafeng Lei
Feiran Wang
Yi-Chun Lu
abstract: Published online: 29 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02152-0 Sulfur-based redox flow batteries promise low-cost, long-duration energy storage using abundant active materials, but commercial success depends on much more than low-cost materials. Yi-Chun Lu and her team explore how deployment reshapes research priorities and reveals the scientific and engineering bottlenecks that determine technology translation.
